title: Agent Composition Disclosure
description: What the director tells the user BEFORE dispatching any implementer for a batch of tasks. One disclosure per batch, not per individual spawn. See DELEGATION-PROTOCOL.md. Work does not start until this has been stated.

task.description: task_id or short description this subagent owns.

subagents.description: One entry per subagent about to be spawned, with the task each owns.

parallel.description: Whether these subagents run concurrently (per CONCURRENCY-RULES.md conflict-domain check) or sequentially.

rescue_agent_available.description: Whether a Rescue Agent promotion (RESCUE-PROTOCOL.md) is actually available in this session/environment if a task fails twice — e.g. whether a stronger model tier is reachable at all.
